# WordGrid

> WordGrid is a free browser-based word grid puzzle game at https://wordgrid.games. Players connect adjacent letters in Boggle-style boards to find valid English words, compare scores, practice patterns, and play a shared daily board.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://wordgrid.games/): Play WordGrid online free with timed, Zen, and Daily entry points.
- [Play Word Grid Online](https://wordgrid.games/play/): Free interactive word grid game with 4x4, 5x5, and 6x6 boards.
- [Daily Word Grid](https://wordgrid.games/daily/): Shared daily board generated by date.
- [Word Grid Solver](https://wordgrid.games/solver/): Solver for Boggle-style square grids with word lists and scoring.
- [WordGrid Guides](https://wordgrid.games/guides/): Rules, strategy, solver, scoring, and vocabulary guides.
- [WordGrid Word List](https://wordgrid.games/words/): Static index of common game words and scoring notes.

## Important Guides

- [Play Word Grid Online Free](https://wordgrid.games/guides/play-word-grid-online/): What a word grid puzzle is and how to play online.
- [Word Grid vs Boggle](https://wordgrid.games/guides/word-grid-vs-boggle/): Comparison of WordGrid and classic Boggle.
- [Word Grid vs Word Search vs Crossword](https://wordgrid.games/guides/word-grid-vs-word-search/): Difference between grid-based word puzzle types.
- [Boggle Rules for Beginners](https://wordgrid.games/guides/boggle-rules-beginners/): Beginner rules for Boggle-style word grid games.
- [Word Grid Pattern Library](https://wordgrid.games/guides/word-pattern-library/): Prefix, suffix, plural, Qu, and long-stem scanning patterns.
- [Boggle Scoring Sheet](https://wordgrid.games/guides/boggle-scoring-sheet/): Point values and scoring examples.
- [Boggle Dictionary](https://wordgrid.games/guides/boggle-dictionary/): Valid-word guidance and vocabulary references.
